title: BitClub Network Founder Russ breaks down the Washington Bitcoin revolution party! BitLife ClubCoin
description: Founder Russ Medlin discusses to the Seattle, WA team why BitClub Network is the best opportunity in the Bitcoin space today ...

And it's not going to stop digging up that gold, but we're digging up that gold. And so every single person, whether they ever introduce any report or not, is going to continually give you Bitcoin every single day from the mining operation that's in place. That I just never seen before things that are done with it so because we have a distribution channel we just keep adding more and more bitcoin revenue streams into the network and our residuals literally will get bigger and bigger and bigger even if we don't have any more new people joining so we got something here that i've never seen before and there's some of the top, top, top networkers on the planet that are joining Big Club Network and not just joining it. Say, oh, they're not buying a spot, but they're building it. They're active. I mean, we're talking about people that have made, you know, not just made, but are making over a million a month in network marketing and see the potential for Big Club Network as so massive that they're actually putting their names on this and getting to work with it. So we have stuff a little bit different here that's really never been seen before in network marketing where we have a true passive program where nobody has to actually do anything to make money. And the way the projections look of what's going to be happening with Bitcoin over the next three, four years, this could be big, big. I mean, somebody could put in a couple thousand dollars and get involved and literally make 10, 20 times the money over the next three years. It could just be insane. Well exactly. I mean the price of Bitcoin. It's just like it keeps I saw Bitcoin go from a dollar Bitcoin to ten dollars Bitcoin to a hundred dollars Bitcoin to 200 to 300 now it's at four hundred dollars of Bitcoin and if Bitcoin stays flat, we're still making 3 to 5% a month. Imagine if Bitcoin goes up to a thousand bucks, two thousand, ten thousand dollars. People are going to be so glad that they're getting paid out in Bitcoin and not getting paid out in dollars literally don't have to sign anyone up to make money in this. There's no automatic order. And obviously, if you do sign some people up, you're going to make some great money. But this is the first deal that I've seen where I can invite everybody in knowing in the deep down, bottom of my heart, I'm not bringing them into a bad deal where I'm just taking their money. I know, oh, this guy sucks at selling. He's got no discipline. He's a quitter, you know, and that's what a lot of people do. They catch the dream of network marketing, but then they just quit because they suck. Right. This one, even people that suck at selling can still make money. What are you going to say, Don? Hey, Russ. At the end of the five-year deal, when the Bitcoin payout drops down and the mining may not be as effective where is that residual income uh passive income going to come to us do we have to be involved in selling the merchant accounts or the cards or what how will that shift at all at that point in time all right so so here's the thing bitcoin has already happened before and after it halved matter because it happened, happened, happened, happened. That doesn't matter because it's always going to make money. Just the way the network is, we can talk about that for an hour. The more profitable it is, the more people mine. The less profitable it is, the less people mine. Which makes it more profitable for the big guys. Russ, in one last minute, could you explain the ATM network in one minute, and I'll cut this video off, please. How big this is going to gonna be and where are you calling from Russ oh so you're in Asia now Russ is all over the world this guy every time I get on the phone with him he's in another country full-on 30 seconds ATM network all right talk about the ATM network say we go get the best Western hotel chain and we put an ATM in every single one of their lobbies how could that benefit members of Big Club Another side, we're building just another revenue stream. annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes BitClub Network as a passive Bitcoin-mining opportunity, claiming participants can receive Bitcoin every day and earn 3–5% monthly without doing anything. It further encourages participation with a projection that someone could put in a couple thousand dollars and make 10–20 times the money, while also describing additional earnings from signing people up. The speakers present these recurring returns and recruitment benefits as reasons to join rather than as a warning or investigation.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: S04 fits because the promoted participation is linked to recurring income from an alleged mining operation: the speaker compares the arrangement to buying equipment in a gold mine and says members receive Bitcoin daily from mining. S06 is additionally supported because the promotion explicitly describes income from signing people up and a network of members and revenue streams.
